hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: With n up to 10^5, an O(n^2) loop is too slow. The shortcut creates a cycle of length abs(x - y) + 1 with two attached tails.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Calculate distances separately for the cycle and both linear tails.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Combine the baseline line contributions, cycle pair counts, and tail-to-cycle transition paths in linear time.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct mathematical counting on cycle and tail subgraphs.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Quadratic all-pairs distance evaluation times out for n = 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary list for distance frequency results.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Decompose graph topology into cycle plus linear tails to achieve linear time.
